notes: Version 3.23 states the hypotheses of the conditional modal envelope: a single oscillatory positive-eigenvalue mode, effective amplitude, linearised dispersion and a specified rate convention. The bound does not select occupations, neutral generators or a unique temporal successor. Lorentzian signature requires the separate second-order finite-characteristic-cone hypothesis [H-hyp] and continuum assumptions, not the capacity bound alone. For 2I with the two order-10 conjugacy classes as generating set (24 elements), the effective-amplitude contrast sqrt(14/9) compares spin 1/2 and spin 5/2 with eigenvalues 18 and 28; it is not an abelian/non-abelian comparison or a dynamical selection rule. No LPS ratio or continuum ratio limit is claimed. The cubic density correction is a proposed model with independent density normalisation and undetermined response coefficient; it is not derived from the rate bound.
